name: Graph Signal Processing Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinements for graph signal pipelines that build a graph, compute a Laplacian, transform to the graph spectrum, and filter or diffuse signals.

operations.name: Validate Connectivity After Build Graph
operations.intent: Check that the constructed graph is connected before later spectral operations assume a coherent graph domain.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check that the graph is connected after it is built.

rewrite.before_summary: Graph construction feeds the next graph signal stage directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A connectivity validation stage is inserted after graph construction.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds graph topology evidence before downstream Laplacian or spectral analysis.

operations.name: Check Laplacian Symmetry
operations.intent: Verify that the Laplacian has the expected symmetry before graph Fourier or filtering logic uses it.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check that the Laplacian matrix is symmetric.

rewrite.before_summary: The computed Laplacian feeds the next graph signal stage directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A symmetry check is inserted after Laplacian computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds a structural validity check for the matrix representation.

operations.name: Analyze Spectral Gap After GFT
operations.intent: Expose weak graph connectivity in the spectral representation before graph filtering decisions are trusted.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a spectral gap check after the graph Fourier transform.

rewrite.before_summary: The graph Fourier transform feeds graph filtering directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A spectral gap analysis stage is inserted after the graph Fourier transform.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds connectivity evidence in the graph spectral domain.

operations.name: Validate Graph Filter Response
operations.intent: Check for unstable graph filter gain after filtering or diffusion.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check that the graph filter response is not too large.

rewrite.before_summary: Graph filtering feeds the downstream result directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A filter-response validation stage is inserted after graph filtering.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds stability evidence for the filtered graph signal.

audit.rationale: Externalizes implemented graph signal processing expansion operations into provider-owned declarative assets.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These are checks that make graph signal pipelines more explicit when the graph, Laplacian, spectrum, or filter response may be unreliable.

references.title: Matcher graph_signal_processing expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/graph_signal_processing.py.
